input.quote: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: Section 3.4 gives Customer a convenience right over the Agreement and individual Service Option Attachments on one month's notice (better than the 60–90 day fallback), and IBM has no convenience right at all — its only termination right is for material breach under 3.3 (the 3.2 ninety-day non-renewal mechanic is a renewal term, not mid-term convenience). The fallback fails on one material term: the early termination charges cross-referenced to Attachment A are open-ended and uncapped, so Customer's exit cost is unquantified. We therefore cap those charges at three months' charges, the fallback ceiling. We have not pursued the preferred pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, which would require broader rewrites; that gap is noted rather than redlined beyond the fee cap.

proposal.summary: Cap early termination charges at three months' charges
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our convenience right is fine, but the early termination charges in Attachment A are open-ended, so we have capped them at three (3) months' charges consistent with our fallback position.
